description: Renders a completed geospatial step's GeoPackage layers (detections, spray_zones, farm_boundary), and/or a drone mission overlay, on an OpenStreetMap basemap. The mission overlay accepts either the generic waypoint JSON a flight_plan/scouting_mission step produces ('mission_json'), or a directory of exported per-format mission files from mission_export/scouting_mission ('mission_files' — .waypoints/.plan/.kmz, pick which one to preview). All three inputs are optional and independent; wire any subset. Design-time only — submits no Tapis job.

inputs.name: mission_json
inputs.description: The generic waypoint JSON from a flight_plan (flight_plan_json) or scouting_mission (mission_json) step — rendered directly, no file picker needed.

inputs.name: mission_files
inputs.description: A directory of exported mission files (mission_export's missions_dir, or scouting_mission's mission_files) — pick which .waypoints/.plan/.kmz/.json to preview.
